title: Household energy transition
intro: Adjust an assumption to see how the modeled scenario changes, starting from the baseline conditions.
visual.aria: Diagram: baseline conditions lead to an operator assumption, which leads to the projected scenario.
visual.text: Baseline conditions → operator assumption → projected scenario
explainer: Household energy transition: how to read the simulation
explainer.lead: The simulation shows one relationship in three steps. The projected scenario is a modeled result, not a measured household outcome.
step1: Baseline conditions are the reference conditions used by the simulation.
step2: An operator-controlled assumption changes an input to the scenario.
step3: The projected scenario is the modeled result of that changed assumption.
market.NL: Example from the Netherlands: household electricity use and tariff choices. This illustrates a scenario, not a bill forecast.
market.BE: Example from Belgium: household energy choices. The model does not predict an individual household result.
market.DE: Example from Germany: household energy choices. The projected scenario is modeled, not measured.
